analysis: Both units are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md, lines 423-788. The supplied input has no patch or head text, so the diff for this file is not visible and I could not examine it. CHANGELOG.md is documentation and has no runtime security effect. The excerpts describe security-relevant behavior that the next pass should compare against code changes elsewhere in the PR. (1) App Attest serves protocol 3 only: protocol 1/2 registrations get no frames, and pre-v3 enrollments never resume (TB-002, TB-011, T-052..T-058). (2) Attestation challenges now fail closed when status_signature or secure_boot_enabled is missing (TB-009, T-036). (3) The unauthenticated /v1/provider/earnings lookup was removed and now returns 404 (T-031). (4) EIGENINFERENCE_MIN_PROVIDER_VERSION now also excludes providers that report no version. (5) The python_hash/runtime_hash wire fields and the python_runtime_locked/dangerous_modules_blocked flags were removed. (6) The SSD cache TTL was raised to 30 minutes and recorded as a SEC-035 re-acceptance (T-041). (7) Prefix-cache holder persistence was added across coordinator restarts and cache-hit pricing was introduced. (8) Public model-demand aggregates apply suppression thresholds of 20 requests and 3 accounts. The changelog claims for items 1-3 should be checked against the actual coordinator and provider code and against the threat-model text. If the threat model still describes the older behavior, for example TB-002 or TB-009 limitation entries, it needs an update. No cross-file interaction could be verified from this input.
